meta.description: Unrestricted-file-upload probes. Every upload sends a short, clearly-marked, inert text body (never executable payload content) under a dangerous extension and a spoofed image Content-Type — testing whether extension/content-type validation exists at all. Nothing uploaded is ever requested for execution.

dangerous_extensions.description: PHP script — executes on Apache/nginx+PHP-FPM if the upload dir is web-reachable
Alternate PHP extension some servers still execute
JSP script — executes on Tomcat/Java app servers
Classic ASP script — executes on IIS
SVG can carry embedded <script> — stored XSS vector when served inline
HTML upload — stored XSS vector when served same-origin
